scope: Local circuits, compiled parity, illustrative logical noise and one archived IBM snapshot only. No service/account/credentials/cloud job/device access. Snapshot is not current calibration.
gate: All120 B endpoints committed, independently audited, root hash-bound evaluation release before actual selected-checkpoint capsule. Synthetic preflight fixtures are separate.

fixtures.selection: Lowest numeric validation record IDs in ascending order, same input rows for every seed/method; labels not used.

measurement.X_basis_rotation: RY(-pi/2) on each of the two logical qubits, followed by Z measurement. XX jointly estimates X0,X1; ZZ jointly estimates Z0,Z1,Z0Z1.
measurement.cost: Scalar consumes one setting and Multi two; common XX rotates both qubits even though Scalar uses X0 only. Charge actual circuits, not minimum gate counts.

ideal.scope: All40 selected checkpoints and32 fixtures, full5 moments before heads; original logical, compiled ideal, production and independent matrix references; preserve raw class differences and declared ambiguity rules.

compile.backend: retained FakeManilaV2 snapshot from IBM Runtime0.50.0
compile.scope: Every required XX/ZZ setting and fixture, full five-qubit target width retained. Save measured native QASM, ideal parity, physical/logical/classical mapping, gates/CX/depth/width. No layout, pair or device search.

noise_scenarios.name: ideal
noise_scenarios.semantics: Exact logical and compiled native circuits; no noise.

noise_scenarios.name: illustrative_mild
noise_scenarios.semantics: v0.5 logical-gate model: after each logical RY/RZ including encoding/readout rotations, and after CX. Applied to original two-qubit logical circuits, never stacked on snapshot noise.

noise_scenarios.name: archived_manila
noise_scenarios.semantics: Aer NoiseModel.from_backend(retained backend) with default documented gate_error/readout_error/thermal_relaxation enabled; compile to retained target. Save full serialized noise model and exact readout matrices. No refresh or live calibration. No extra mitigation.

snapshot_density: Remove final measurements from the saved compiled circuit. Simulate native gates with snapshot quantum channels, marginalize measured physical qubits in recorded classical-bit order, then apply asymmetric independent readout matrices extracted from serialized noise model. Reject unsupported correlated readout. Idle wires remain in recorded width; no extra idle/delay noise invented.

finite_shot.sampling: Joint four-outcome multinomial per setting; reuse joint counts for observables in that setting. Do not sample moments independently.
finite_shot.rng: NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([690101,population_index,training_seed,method_index,scenario_index,shots,replicate_index,setting_index]); indices zero based in registered orders.
finite_shot.head: Apply fixed saved sigmoid head once to noisy estimated moments; record bias/variance and class disagreements. Plug-in nonlinear-head output is generally biased.
finite_shot.cost: Scalar total N shots per input/repeat; Multi2N. Save every count vector and predictor output; separate represented multinomial trials from actual Aer shots.

aer_measured_smoke.scope: Run actual saved measured native circuits with ideal/full snapshot NoiseModel. Retain counts and compare with density-plus-readout expectations. Standardized residuals descriptive, no stochastic winner or accuracy gate.

independent_audit: Independently reconstruct ideal moments/heads and logical mild channels; verify snapshot identity, QASM/mapping and saved native quantum/readout channel tables; independently replay density channel application and joint-count generation/head application. Record exactly which compilation/Aer executions were not separately rerun.
outputs: Checkpoint/input identities, original and compiled ideal parity, exact density distributions/noise serialization, every joint draw/head prediction, measured-Aer counts, resource totals, aggregate and maximum errors. Fixture labels are not primary generalization outcomes.
limits: Historical2024 snapshot, approximate noise, no crosstalk/calibration drift/device queue/real hardware validation.32 reused validation fixtures per population, five training seeds. No selection based on noise outcomes.
